workshops.title: Coffee with Your Inner Critic
workshops.tagline: Meeting the voice that holds you back, with curiosity instead of a fight.
workshops.intro:
It's not good enough yet. Who do you think you are? Just one more check before you send it.

Most of us know that voice. And most of us have tried to argue with it, ignore it or shout it down. It rarely works.

In this workshop we sit down with the inner critic over a cup of coffee and get curious about it. What is it trying to do for you? What is it afraid would happen if it stopped?

Even the loud, critical one has a good reason for what it does.
foryou: You know a voice that says it's not good enough yet
You get in your own way and wonder, "Why can't I just do it?"
You're curious about parts-work and don't know where to start

steps.title: Landing
steps.text: We arrive, with a cup of coffee.

steps.title: Parts-work in plain words
steps.text: What a "part" is, and why there are no bad ones.

steps.title: Meeting your critic
steps.text: A short guided exercise with your notebook.

steps.title: Two questions
steps.text: We ask the critic what it's trying to do for you, and what it's afraid of.

steps.title: Sharing
steps.text: In pairs, then in the group, as much or as little as you like.

steps.title: Closing
steps.text: We thank the part, and you take home a card with the questions for the next time it shows up.
